name: Regal Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Regal Holding Co., Ltd. is a global enterprise primarily focused on the creation and distribution of fine jewelry and gemstones. Its comprehensive operations include the design, manufacturing, and specialized electroplating of a diverse product line featuring pendants, rings, wristbands, earrings, bracelets, necklaces, and other accessories. The company maintains a significant international presence, conducting business in key markets such as Thailand, the United States, France, the United Kingdom, and Canada, among other worldwide regions. Beyond its core jewelry activities, Regal Holding also engages in the wholesale trade of diamonds, the sale of high-value precious jewelry, and various general trading endeavors. Established in 2014, the company's headquarters are located in Grand Cayman, Cayman Islands.
